pending.title: Office Paper Explosion Portrait
pending.prompt: A dynamic, frozen-in-time scene where the person in the photo is standing in the center of an office explosion of paperwork. Thousands of white sheets of paper are suspended in mid-air around the subject in a spiral pattern. The subject is wearing a sleek black turtleneck and glasses, standing perfectly still and calm amidst the chaos, looking at the camera. Use a [LENS_STYLE: 50mm] lens effect to capture the depth of the paper storm, dramatic high-key studio lighting with rim lighting on every sheet of paper to define the edges, and a shallow depth of field that blurs the papers closest to the lens and furthest away. Hyper-realistic skin tones and a cinematic atmosphere. Keep the person's face and identity unchanged. Include a small handwritten cursive artist signature "Bilal x" in the bottom-right with a thin hairline stroke, no glow.
